# EAFIT celebrates another PhD, bringing its total to six.

**The Ministry of National Education granted the University the qualified registration to offer the doctorate in Economics.**

**It is the sixth program of its kind at the Institution, which also offers programs in Administration, Engineering, Humanities, Earth Sciences, and Mathematical Engineering.**

- [Start](https://www.eafit.edu.co/)
- [News](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias)
- [Our Impact](https://www.eafit.edu.co/noticias/nuestro-impacto)
- EAFIT Celebrates Another PhD and Adds Six to Its List

![EAFIT celebrates another PhD, adding six to its list](https://universidadeafit.widen.net/content/82df1390-0e7a-41c2-a299-0b2582433649/web/nuevo-doctorado.jpg?crop=yes&k=c&w=823&h=450&itok=JqsKQID7)

The team from the School of Economics and Finance at EAFIT worked for about three years to obtain the qualified registration for the PhD in Economics that the University will soon offer.

Good news has arrived at EAFIT University, courtesy of the School of Economics and Finance! Yes, on the afternoon of Friday, July 24, the Ministry of National Education informed the University, through resolution number 10415 of July 14, 2015, that it has granted it the accreditation to offer a doctoral program in Economics, a program offered by only five universities in Colombia. Furthermore, it is the first of its kind in Medellín.

Thus, in the words of Juan Luis Mejía Arango, Rector of EAFIT, this news fulfills the dream of having another doctoral program at the University—making it six programs at that level—and this reflects the Institution's effort to train and recruit doctoral graduates. “When we drew up the University's Development Plan, we wanted to consolidate our undergraduate programs, but also expand into second and third cycles of university studies, especially master's and doctoral programs.”

In turn, for Juan Felipe Mejía Mejía, dean of the School of Economics and Finance, the new doctorate has the support of three high-level international institutions: in the United States, the American University (Washington DC) and Brandeis University (Boston), and in Belgium, the Catholic University of Louvain.

Another feature that makes this program special is that it's an Economics program with a focus on Finance, and the University expects this differentiating factor to make it very important in the Latin American region. Regarding its future prospects, the Dean believes that "for a School that generates high-quality, internationally relevant research, this will bring greater visibility, but above all, the ability to interact more effectively with the scientific community."

To reap these fruits, it took about three years of work by a team that included Diego Alexander Restrepo Tobón, a professor in the Department of Finance, who maintains that the achievement is a recognition of the maturity in the research and extension processes of EAFIT.

Diego Alexander explains that among the conditions evaluated to grant the registration are the capacity of the teaching staff - the School has 22 PhDs, plus those currently aspiring to that title - the experience of the Institution - it offers undergraduate, specialization and master's degrees in Economics and Finance - and the infrastructure to offer optimal conditions to students - for example, the capacity for mobility abroad and the arrival of teachers from other universities.

###### The profile of the graduates

While the decision to pursue a doctorate is largely driven by vocation, given the effort and time required to obtain the degree, Alejandro Torres García, a professor in the Department of Economics, points out that a doctorate is increasingly necessary for joining academia. Furthermore, companies are realizing the need to attract personnel who generate research and knowledge that will allow them to differentiate themselves from their competitors and increase profitability.

In the program that EAFIT will soon begin offering, students will be able to receive training from professors at partner universities abroad, and even complete internships or part of their doctoral work outside the country. Regarding the graduates' profile, Diego Alexander explains that they will be able to work in academia and will have the skills to work in the public and private sectors as expert consultants or high-level researchers.

The program is designed to last four years, with full-time dedication, but the curriculum can be adapted to the needs of those with work obligations so they can take a certain number of courses while continuing to work. Likewise, the courses in the University's Master's programs in Economics and Finance are validated toward the doctoral program, meaning students can complete almost half of the program already.

Thus, with the new information provided by the Ministry, EAFIT is already looking forward to offering this program, which consolidates its objective of being a teaching and research university and strengthens one of the newest schools in the institution, since the School of Economics and Finance was created in 2012.

###### Lines of research

There are several research areas that aspiring PhD students in Economics at EAFIT can focus on. Gustavo Canavire Bacarreza, director of the Center for Economic and Financial Research (CIEF) at EAFIT, explains that currently the lines of research supporting the program are financial markets, corporate finance, public policy, macroeconomics, spatial economics, and industrial organization.

Gustavo also believes that the registration granted by the Ministry is a recognition of the research work carried out by the University in these areas and hopes that the new program will strengthen the quantity and quality of scientific production in this field.

metadata.title: EAFIT celebrates another doctorate, bringing its total to six - EAFIT University
metadata.og:title: EAFIT celebra un doctorado más y suma seis a su lista
metadata.description: ¡La buena nueva llegó a EAFIT por cuenta de la Escuela de Economía y Finanzas! Sí, la tarde del viernes 24 de julio el Ministerio de Educación Nacional le comunicó a la Universidad, mediante la resolución número 10415 del 14 de julio de 2015, que le otorga el registro calificado para ofrecer el doctorado en Economía, un programa que únicamente ofrecen cinco universidades en Colombia. Además, se trata del primero de este tipo en Medellín.
